_comment: One entry per tool/service with its own network needs. Both init-firewall.sh and refresh-allowlist.sh derive their domain list from this file via domains-from-manifest.sh, so a domain only ever needs to be added in one place. Record WHY each host is needed and where that requirement is documented upstream; a bare domain string in a firewall script can't carry that context, and the next person editing the allowlist needs it to know whether a domain is still needed at all.

<tool-a-key>.reason: Resolves and downloads packages this tool installs at runtime.

<tool-b-key>.reason: API calls plus release-binary downloads for this CLI's self-update check.

<tool-c-key>.reason: Project's own git forge and documentation host.

<agentic-cli-d-key>-install.reason: npm registry this agentic CLI's own binary is installed and updated from.

<agentic-cli-d-key>-vendor-api.reason: This CLI's own inference/auth backend -- distinct from the npm registry entry above, which only gets the binary installed. Without this entry the CLI installs and MCP-wires cleanly but cannot serve a single prompt once the firewall is active.
